subject: Review execution brain state seam retry
description: Judge the retry implementation for separating execution brain/memory and local/git state. Use code-review stance: inspect the retry attempt diff against its base, verify the implementation keeps local live process/session/worktree state out of git-synced claim files, treats git claims as durable/advisory audit by default with strict mode available, stores git-claim diagnostics as local-only overlay state, updates config parsing and tests, and preserves existing orchestration gate behavior. Do not force-merge; approve only if tests pass and scope is disciplined.
